name: Payfast

evidence.gateway: F02: aggregation collects for the merchant into a Payfast balance; the seller keeps delivery
evidence.billing: F14: automatic recurring card subscriptions; F15: amount, date and frequency changes, retries
evidence.links: F16: emailed Payment Requests can be sent to buyers, alongside Pay Now and Subscribe buttons

line: South African checkout gateway with payment requests and recurring cards.

free.text: No setup/monthly fee; R115 inactivity fee after 12 months

cells.countries: South African bank required; residency not required
cells.payout: 48-hour hold; bank arrival 1–2 workdays after request

fee.math: The published rate is 3.2% plus R2 (South African rand), for South African merchants. It isn't published whether US sellers are eligible, and no US rate is published.
